summary: Fase 5 Settings redesign (/settings) — Notion-style progressive-disclosure preferences flow. Executed end-to-end Playwright verification against preview URL for all 8 acceptance criteria. All criteria PASS. No regressions, no legacy chrome, no console errors.
verified_criteria: Header typography: whisper 'Ajustes' rendered uppercase via CSS (computed 'AJUSTES', letter-spacing 3.08px ≈ 0.28em, 11px, font-weight 500). Title 'Preferencias' with font-weight 500, letter-spacing -1.344px (-0.03em), font-size 44.8px, General Sans family. Body paragraph 'Ajustá cómo suena, se siente y se mide SoundMap. Los cambios se guardan solos.' present.

Six accordion cards inside [data-testid='settings-sections']. Each section + toggle testid found: measurement, feedback, venue, guide, about, danger. Only measurement expanded on load — all other 5 sections had hasVisibleBody=false. After clicking feedback toggle, measurement collapses to summary 'Medición / Sistema imperial'.

measurement open by default. units-segment with pills units-segment-metric (bg rgb(244,245,247) white, color rgb(9,9,11) black — active) and units-segment-imperial (bg rgba(0,0,0,0) transparent, muted). Click imperial swaps: metric→transparent, imperial→white. Summary text updates to 'Sistema imperial' when collapsed.

feedback section reveals toggle-sound and toggle-haptics as h-6 w-11 (44x24 px) rounded pills. Initial state showed toggle-sound bg rgb(91,167,119) (=#5BA777 sage) when on; after click bg rgba(255,255,255,0.06) (subtle white) when off. Toggle animates via motion.div knob.

venue-grid renders 4 buttons: venue-club, venue-festival, venue-theatre, venue-conference. Each includes a Lucide icon + label + hint. venue-club active by default with sage-tinted bg rgba(91,167,119,0.07) and 2 svgs (icon + Check). After clicking venue-festival, festival gets 2 svgs (active with Check) and club drops to 1 svg (Check removed). Active hairline uses sage HUE_ON.

guide expanded: replay-tour-btn found with text 'Iniciar' + ArrowRight icon, ghost pill style. about expanded shows three read-only rows — Aplicación (SoundMap), Versión (v5.0.0 mono), Motor (SoundMap Engine).

danger section title color rgb(180,92,110) = #B45C6E warm-red. reset-system-btn opens reset-overlay modal. Modal shows AlertTriangle icon, heading '¿Borrar todos los datos?', body copy about deletion, reset-cancel-btn (ghost) and reset-confirm-btn (bg rgb(180,92,110) = HUE_DANGER solid). Cancel click closes modal. Backdrop click (outside dialog) also closes modal. Confirm was intentionally NOT clicked to preserve state.

No legacy artifacts inside .max-w-3xl wrapper: 0 .glass-card, 0 .font-black, 0 .tracking-wider. Only 1 uppercase-transformed element found: the whisper

'Ajustes' with font-weight 500 (matches spec). All body text is font-medium or default. Font family General Sans confirmed.
critical_code_review_comments: Excellent adherence to Notion-style spec. Progressive disclosure implemented cleanly via a single openSection state, guaranteeing only-one-open behavior.

Minor: /app/src/pages/settings/index.tsx line 39 uses `feedback('tap')` on section toggle — fine, but consider matching the whisper label copy: the header

uses literal 'Ajustes' with CSS uppercase. The whisper renders correctly as 'AJUSTES', but if the design tokens later strip uppercase-transform globally the label would break. Consider a data-testid on the whisper label (e.g. 'settings-whisper') for future robustness — non-blocking.
Danger hue #B45C6E is applied consistently on section title, row label, reset button pill, and confirm button — good token discipline.
backdrop-close on ResetConfirmDialog uses onClick on outer motion.div and stopPropagation on inner — correct pattern.

File is 499 lines, right at the recommended threshold. If more sections are added, consider extracting Section/Row/SegmentControl/Toggle/ResetConfirmDialog to /src/components/settings/ for reuse and readability.
seed_data_creation: None. Settings uses Zustand persist key 'soundmap-settings' — no seeding required. Tests observed initial defaults (metric, club active, sound=on).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fase 5 Settings page passes all 8 acceptance criteria. Zustand store 'soundmap-settings' toggles Units/Venue/Sound/Haptics correctly. Reset dialog cancel + backdrop close verified; confirm NOT clicked to avoid wiping state. If future iterations need to test resetSystem behavior end-to-end, seed sample recinto/equipment first, then click reset-confirm-btn and verify AppStore state clears while soundmap-settings persists.
